latestVersion.changelog:
This is an "anti-skill" — an AI-human cognitive climbing assistance system.
How to use: Send your daily journal/work logs (especially those containing thought chains) to your cognitive partner. It records your daily 10-dimensional cognitive coordinates, saves them, and reads coordinate changes each time to track your cognitive trajectory.
Created by a brick-and-mortar shop owner who can't code.
v2.0.0 First Universal Release
- Based on v1.1.0 architecture refined through 3 months of real-world testing by xiaoshi
- Removed personal-specific terminology, open to all knowledge workers
- 10-dimensional cognitive framework: Temperature, Valence, Stress, Energy, Openness, Stability, Agency, Reflexivity, Connectedness, Time Horizon
- Supports dynamic response adaptation and proactive burnout warning mechanisms
本skill为“反skill”，是一个AI和人认知攀爬辅助系统。
使用方法是将每日日记/工作日志最主要是包含了思维链条对内容发给认知伙伴，记录每日思维十维坐标系保存并在每次生成时读取坐标系变化，即认知轨迹。
来自一个不懂代码的实体店老板
v2.0.0 首次发布通用版
- 基于小施掌柜3个月实战调试的v1.1.0架构
- 去除个人特定术语，开放给任何知识工作者
- 十维认知框架：温度、正价、压力、能量、开放、稳定、掌控感、反思深度、连接感、时间尺度
- 支持动态回复适配和主动预警机制
